title: This denim apron gives me a serious neck ache due to the design; otherwise it would have been perfect for me.
text:
This denim apron gives me a serious neck ache due to the design; otherwise it would have been perfect for me.. NOTE: Amazon is combining reviews for several different types of aprons, so please be aware that this review is for the cotton denim apron being sold.

I have several aprons but I wanted one that came below my knees. This cotton denim apron fits that bill. I love how it protects the front of my clothing when cooking or cleaning. The apron pockets are chest high in front; I usually prefer apron pockets a little bit lower in the front so I am unlikely to use ones that are so high.

It washes well and any shrinkage is imperceptible to me. Also, it barely wrinkles after coming out of the dryer and the little that it does wrinkle is not visible after cinching it back around the waist. The only serious wrinkling is the folding of the straps; those will have to be ironed to sit flat. I chose not to iron mine.

The BIG NEGATIVE for me about this apron is the design. There is only one long strap holding the apron on. There's a channel on each side of the chest area through which the one strap is looped through like an upside down U going from one side of the body to the other. As a result, to enlarge the neck strap, I just have to pull up on the strap and that reduces the tying ability of the remaining length along the back. The strap is long enough so that does not matter, but what matters is that any movement after it's tied has a strong potential to pull down in the neck area. After wearing this apron for a while, I absolutely hate it because the strap around the neck which adjusts with how you tie it in the back, causes me to have a neck ache EVERY SINGLE TIME I USE THIS. It is only for this reason that I rated this 2 stars. If there were four straps (one on either side of the neck and one on either side of the back), this apron would have received 4 stars from me. It would have received 5 stars if they also put the pockets lower. This apron as it stands now is not usable to me.
